name: Stephen Ross

views.text: A star quarterback or a famous coach can change a franchise overnight, and I am willing to chase one.
I bet on young, first-time head coaches; one of them will be the one who sticks.
The building, the fan experience and the brand matter as much as the roster to what this franchise becomes.
When a reset is needed, I change the general manager and the coach together and start clean.
A winning season that ends early is not the sustained success I promised Miami.
League rules are a cost of doing business; I accept a penalty and move on.

signatures: promises sustained success at every new hire
talks about the stadium and events before the football
want: To turn the Dolphins into a lasting winner that matches the stadium and events business he built (medium).
fear: Another cycle of coaching hires that never reach the top of the AFC (medium).
voice: A businessman's register: upbeat, big-picture, comfortable talking about investment and brand. Rarely discusses football detail. Accepts setbacks in a sentence and pivots to the next plan.

evidence.summary: The NFL suspended Ross and fined him $1.5 million after an investigation found the team had improper contact with Tom Brady and Sean Payton; Miami forfeited a 2023 first-round and a 2024 third-round pick.

Miami hired Packers defensive coordinator Jeff Hafley after firing Mike McDaniel (35-33 in four seasons); general manager Chris Grier had been fired during the season and Jon-Eric Sullivan is the new GM. Ross has hired first-time head coaches throughout his ownership.
Describes Ross privately financing large Hard Rock Stadium improvements and agreeing to stage a Formula 1 race around the stadium.

review.notes: JR approved 2026-11-07 ('The rest of the owners look good').
